name: Repair Room

features.name: Repair Workbench
features.description: A live electronics repair bench combining PCB camera, AI overlay highlights, measurement panel, knowledge pack viewer, and operator profile awareness.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomUiReady
commandSpecs.description: Signal that the Repair Room UI is attached and ready.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomActivateSession
commandSpecs.description: Switch the active repair session in the workbench.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomCreateSession
commandSpecs.description: Create a new repair session draft from the session wizard.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomUpdateSession
commandSpecs.description: Patch active session fields (device info, symptoms, risk level).

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomArchiveSession
commandSpecs.description: Move a session into the archive group.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomDeleteSession
commandSpecs.description: Delete a saved repair session and its room-local stored data.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomAdvanceWizard
commandSpecs.description: Move the new-session wizard to the next or named step.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomStartKnowledgeResearch
commandSpecs.description: Start Assistant AI evidence research for the current wizard draft.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomSkipKnowledgeResearch
commandSpecs.description: Continue the repair intake without Assistant AI evidence research.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomUpdateEvidenceSelection
commandSpecs.description: Update the evidence resources, failures, and test points selected for the session archive.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomAddKnowledgeResource
commandSpecs.description: Add an operator-provided schematic, board image, datasheet, thread, or note to the current knowledge pack.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomAddKnowledgeFailure
commandSpecs.description: Stage an operator-provided common failure in the wizard evidence review.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomAddKnowledgeTestPoint
commandSpecs.description: Stage an operator-provided rail or probe point in the wizard evidence review.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomAddKnowledgeNote
commandSpecs.description: Stage an operator-provided repair note in the wizard evidence review.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomRemoveKnowledgeEvidence
commandSpecs.description: Stage removal of a resource, failure, test point, or note from the wizard evidence review.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomAttachKnowledgePack
commandSpecs.description: Attach a generated knowledge pack to the active session.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomSetActiveTool
commandSpecs.description: Select the active workbench tool (annotation, measurement, freeze-frame, etc.).

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomToggleFreezeFrame
commandSpecs.description: Toggle the workbench live/freeze-frame state.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomToggleOverlayLayer
commandSpecs.description: Toggle visibility of an overlay layer (grid, AI marks, annotations, pins).

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomAddTimelineEvent
commandSpecs.description: Append a structured timeline event (annotation, measurement, note, AI mark, risk flag).

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomJumpToEvent
commandSpecs.description: Select and focus a timeline event in the workbench and feed.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomScrubTimeline
commandSpecs.description: Move the visual timeline playhead to a specific session time.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomAddMeasurement
commandSpecs.description: Record a measurement reading and attach it to the active session.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomDismissAiMark
commandSpecs.description: Acknowledge or dismiss an Assistant AI feed event or overlay mark.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomSetAiTargetSlot
commandSpecs.description: Select the AI slot used for project-bound repair assistant messages.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomSendChatTurn
commandSpecs.description: Append an operator turn to the Assistant AI session chat and request a response.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomSetChatComposer
commandSpecs.description: Persist the Repair Room chat composer draft for typed or dictated text.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomUpdateOperatorProfile
commandSpecs.description: Patch the operator profile (tools, skills, preferences).

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomUpdateViewport
commandSpecs.description: Update workbench viewport zoom and pan without changing panel layout.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomUpdateTimeline
commandSpecs.description: Update visual timeline zoom and range controls.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomUpdatePanelLayout
commandSpecs.description: Persist a single panel collapse or pin state change.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomUpdatePanelTab
commandSpecs.description: Switch a Repair Room panel tab or instrument tab.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomUpdateFocus
commandSpecs.description: Toggle Repair Room focus mode independently from other layout state.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomSetOperationalProfile
commandSpecs.description: Switch Repair Room between novice and advanced operational density profiles.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomSetVoiceGuidance
commandSpecs.description: Update ambient listening and hands-busy spoken guidance preferences.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomSetInteractionSettings
commandSpecs.description: Update Repair Room hands-free route preferences for dictation, TTS, camera feed, and companion access.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomSetSettingsOverlay
commandSpecs.description: Open, close, or switch the Repair Room settings overlay tab.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomStartDictation
commandSpecs.description: Start Repair Room dictation through the central capture runtime.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomStopDictation
commandSpecs.description: Stop the Repair Room dictation request owned by this room.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomStartAmbientListener
commandSpecs.description: Start ambient listening through the central capture runtime for hands-free repair.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomStopAmbientListener
commandSpecs.description: Stop the Repair Room ambient listener request owned by this room.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomStartCameraFeed
commandSpecs.description: Start the Android camera feed for the Repair Room workbench.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomStopCameraFeed
commandSpecs.description: Stop the Repair Room camera feed request owned by this room.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomCapturePhoto
commandSpecs.description: Capture the current Android camera frame and attach it as the active board image.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomSetCameraTorch
commandSpecs.description: Toggle the Android companion torch for the Repair Room workbench camera.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomSpeakGuidance
commandSpecs.description: Read the current Repair Room guidance line through the central TTS runtime.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomStopSpeech
commandSpecs.description: Stop the Repair Room TTS request owned by this room.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomSetAttentionBudget
commandSpecs.description: Update AI interruption budget limits for calm guidance.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomToggleInvestigationMode
commandSpecs.description: Toggle the projection-driven spatial investigation overlay mode.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomSelectOverlayEntities
commandSpecs.description: Select command-addressable overlay entities by semantic refs.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomFocusOverlayEntity
commandSpecs.description: Focus a command-addressable overlay entity and reveal its spatial context.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomFocusInvestigationRegion
commandSpecs.description: Focus an event-backed investigation region by stable region id.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomFocusKnowledgeSpatialRef
commandSpecs.description: Focus a knowledge-pack spatial reference and expose temporary overlay context.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomPromoteKnowledgeRegion
commandSpecs.description: Promote a knowledge-pack spatial reference into a canonical investigation region event.

commandSpecs.name: RepairRoomFocusLiveEdge
commandSpecs.description: Return overlay focus and replay state to the live edge.

workbench.label: Repair Workbench
workbench.description: Live PCB stage with overlay annotations, Assistant AI flow, measurement panel, knowledge pack viewer, and operator profile awareness.

description: An electronics repair workstation that combines a live PCB workbench, Assistant AI flow, knowledge pack research, and operator-aware diagnostic guidance.
